subject: Intermittent errors & latency spike — request for goodwill credit and trial extension
messages:
From: James Lee <james@brightcart.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-28 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Intermittent errors and latency spike — impact on rollout

Hi Kimberly —

We shipped a staged rollout this morning and started seeing a spiked error rate and 2–3s added tail latency for several endpoints between 08:40–09:10 UTC. The errors caused about 1% of customer requests to fail with 5xx and a few of our beta users reported timeouts. Our rollout had to be paused while we triaged.

We depend on your inference path for low latency during our feature gate. This incident directly blocked our production rollout and created an internal outage call for ~45 minutes. Can you confirm root cause and propose a goodwill remedy? Specifically we are asking for:

- One month trial extension (we're mid-trial)
- A one-time credit to offset tokens lost during failures and the operational impact

Attached: error_snapshot.log (request IDs and sample stack traces).

James Lee
Head of Engineering, BrightCart
james@brightcart.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: James Lee <james@brightcart.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-28 10:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Intermittent errors and latency spike — impact on rollout

Thanks for the details and for sending the log snippets, James. I’m very sorry this impacted your rollout — we take these regressions seriously.

Quick next steps from our side:
- I’ve escalated to our SRE + Product (cc'd Aditya and Marissa) to correlate the request IDs.
- We’ll run a post-incident analysis and follow up with a timeline and root cause.
- As an immediate gesture, I can propose a trial extension and a one-time credit while we validate scope. Please confirm whether you want the credit applied to the billing contact (billing@brightcart.com) or as a service token top-up to your account.

I’ll be back with a concrete proposal within 24 hours once we confirm usage and impact.

— Kimberly Park
Director, Growth & Accounts | Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.ai

>

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-28 11:30:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: Intermittent errors and latency spike — impact on rollout (BrightCart)

Team — forwarding James’ note and log snippet. TL;DR: BrightCart had ~45m of increased errors/latency during a rollout window. They’re asking for a trial extension + a one-time credit.

I ran a quick usage pull for June 28 08:30–09:30 UTC (attached worksheet) and estimate ~1.2M token equivalents during the window with ~1% failures. My rough proposal:
- Trial extension: 60 days (they are mid-trial and close to converting)
- Token credit: $5,000 equivalent (covers lost capacity + operational remediation, aligns with our precedent for similarly sized customers)

Rationale: they are a high-growth retail customer in US with likely expansion (DEAL-8294). A smaller credit (e.g., $2k–3k) might look stingy given revenue velocity; legal should bless the wording in the credit agreement.

Attachments: credit-calculation-worksheet.xlsx (worksheet with usage slices).

Please reply with approvals or edits — if we agree I’ll draft the one-page credit agreement and apply the token top-up to billing@brightcart.com.

— Kimberly

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-29 08:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Fwd: Intermittent errors and latency spike — impact on rollout (BrightCart)

Kimberly —

I reviewed the worksheet and logs. I support the 60-day extension but recommend rounding the credit to $5,000 (rather than any lower figure) given the disruption to their rollout and the likely near-term ARR. Finance will ok up to $6k on precedent; $5k is conservative.

Olga — please confirm any legal language we should avoid (don’t call it an admission of fault; frame as a service credit for operational impact).

Approved from my side. Kimberly, proceed to draft the agreement and notify billing contact so we can apply the credit.

— Aditya

On Tue, Jun 28, 2027 at 11:30 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team — forwarding James’ note and log snippet...
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-29 12:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Credit language for BrightCart

All —

Legal is fine with the proposed structure. Two notes for the one-page credit agreement:
1) Wording: Phrase as 'service goodwill credit' and explicitly state that the credit is not an admission of liability and is limited to the amounts set forth.
2) Mechanics: We apply the credit to the customer billing account (billing@brightcart.com) and expire any unused portion after 12 months.

I’ve attached a short agreement template we use for these cases (I will add the BEGS clause).

— Olga

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: James Lee <james@brightcart.com>
Cc: BrightCart Billing <billing@brightcart.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-30 14:02:00 +0000
Subject: Resolution: goodwill credit and trial extension (BrightCart)

Hi James —

Thanks again for flagging this and for patience while we reviewed the impact. Here’s what we’re authorizing as a gesture to address the outage you experienced on 2027-06-28: 

- One-time service goodwill credit: $5,000 (applied to your billing account: billing@brightcart.com)
- Trial extension: 60 days added to your existing trial window
- Expiration: unused credit expires 12 months after issuance

Next steps:
1) Attached: credit-agreement-BrightCart.pdf — please review and confirm signature from your billing contact. The agreement states the credit is a goodwill gesture and not an admission of liability.
2) Once we receive confirmation from billing@brightcart.com, Finance will apply the credit within 3 business days.

We’ve also completed a brief post-incident analysis: the spike was caused by a transient routing mismatch during a kernel rollout; a fix was deployed at 09:18 UTC and we have mitigations to prevent recurrence. I’ll share the postmortem in a separate note.

If you’d like the credit applied as a token top-up instead of a billing credit, say the word and we’ll arrange that.

Appreciate the partnership, James — let me know when you’re ready to re-open your rollout and our SREs can join the window.

— Kimberly Park
Director, Growth & Accounts | Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.ai
Attachments: credit-agreement-BrightCart.pdf (1 page)
